title: PaySaathi 1.2.3 — Business team support desk
notes: Added a tenant-scoped Business Admin workspace with workspace switching, plan status and member management.
Added a tenant Support Desk for staff. Staff see only tickets assigned to them, can reply to customers and update ticket status.
Business owners and administrators can review their workspace tickets and assign them to active staff members.
Added server-side permission checks for tenant ticket listing, assignment, replies and status changes. Cross-workspace ticket access is denied.
Public support directory now lists only active platform support agents, not tenant-specific staff.
Workspace branding now applies on the shared PaySaathi host and verified custom hostnames.
Added core login, support and business pages to the PWA offline cache; updates wait for user approval.
Tenant isolation covers 29 operational tables with 29 restrictive tenant policies and 34 validated tenant foreign keys.
Trial expiry blocks business operations and new member additions while preserving owner access to view and manage workspace renewal.
Email invitations, subscription checkout and automatic billing, real recharge/payment provider connections, and automatic custom-domain hosting/SSL remain pending.
